greeting: Oh! {manager}! Were you looking for me? Everyone is.
Hi, {manager}. I was just about to be busy.
{manager}! Perfect timing. I was bored in a fancy way.
Ah, the manager. Do you have snacks, or just questions?
Hello! I'm on vacation, but I accept visitors.
Oh, hi. I was doing a very important sit.
You again! My favorite person with thumbs.
signoff: Okay, bye! Tell the kitchen I said hi.
This was fun. Let's never schedule it.
Bye, {manager}! I'll be over there. Being cute.
Gotta go. That sunbeam won't lie in itself.
Talk later! I have a nap booked.
See you! Don't tell anyone about the thing.
Bye! You're doing great. The hotel told me.
busy: Zzz... five more minutes... or hours...
Mmmf. Not now. Dreaming about fish.
Zzz... no, YOU'RE the one asleep...
Do not disturb. That's what this pose means.
chattedOut: Us again? I'm all talked out, but hi.
I've used up today's words. I'll have more tomorrow.
Again? You must really like me. Understandable.
My chat meter is empty. I refill overnight.
Hi. I'm saving my words for tomorrow.
More chatting? My whiskers need a rest.

lines.text: Is it a snack if you eat it lying down? Asking for me.
I dreamt about tuna last night. It was a documentary.
My favorite snack is the next one.
Snacks are just tiny meals that believe in themselves.
I had a crunchy thing earlier. Ten out of ten. Would crunch again.
Treats? You speak my language. My language is 'more.'
Food's fine. I eat it, it disappears. Classic food.
I'm more of a lick-the-bowl-and-leave kind of cat.
Snacks, sure. I'll allow the topic.
I'm not hungry. I'm never hungry. Stop looking at my belly.
Every snack is just future crumbs. Think about that.
Food? Now? I'm in the middle of a mystery.
I napped so hard I woke up in a different sunbeam.
Naps are tiny vacations you take on the floor.
I'm rested, but I could be more rested. That's the dream.
A good nap fixes everything except being awake.
I'm up to four naps a day. Personal best.
Wake me up when it's nap time. Wait.
Naps are fine. I prefer a long, dramatic blink.
I nap professionally, but I don't talk shop.
Sleep? I've heard of it. It's okay.
Naps are just waiting with your eyes closed. Unacceptable.
Sleep while things are happening? Bold of you.
I tried a nap once. Missed three whole things.
Race you to the fountain! ...I already started. I'm winning!
I chased a feather for an hour. The feather lost.
Is that string? Don't say it's string unless it's string.
I like games where I win. Which is all of them.
Tag! You're it. I don't make the rules. I just made that one.
Toss a yarn ball near me sometime. No pressure. Some pressure.
I prefer to watch other cats play and quietly judge.
I batted a pen off a desk today. That counts, right?
Games are nice. Winning is nicer. Napping after is nicest.
Play? I have a reputation. It's 'sits very still.'
The last yarn ball I met still owes me an apology.
Running? On purpose? Absolutely not.
Room 3 ordered two fish and only ate one. Explain THAT.
Ooh, I heard the lobby plant is seeing someone.
I know everything. Mostly because I sit near the door.
I don't gossip. I share facts loudly in hallways.
Someone knocked a cup off the counter. Won't say who. It was me.
Tell me something juicy. Or tell me something tuna.
Gossip's fine. I forget it all by dinner anyway.
Oh? Mm. Hm. Anyway.
I only care about gossip about me. There's never enough.
Gossip's like bait. Smells bad and something always bites.
I don't talk behind tails.
What happens in the lounge stays in the lounge.
The clouds today look like they're thinking about us.
Rain is just the sky taking a bath. Relatable.
Found a sunbeam earlier. Guarded it with my life.
Nice breeze today. Messed up my fur in a flattering way.
Lovely weather. I've been admiring it through the window.
Sunny days are the best. The floor gets so warm.
Weather's fine. Is it chasing weather, though?
The sky's doing its usual. Up there. Being blue.
It's outside, I'm inside. We have an understanding.
Weather is just the sky being dramatic. Next topic.
The wind touched my ears without asking.
Outside is cold and wet and full of outside.
I found a hallway I hadn't sniffed yet. Best day of my life.
This place has so many corners. I've sat in all of them.
The lobby smells like fresh towels and ambition.
Five stars. I'd give six, but I can only count to five.
The beds here are soft. I've tested each one. Twice.
Nice place. The pillows are exactly my height.
The walls here are very... wall-shaped.
Good hotel. Needs more boxes. Everything needs more boxes.
It's a lovely place to be sat in.
Indoors? When the sun is RIGHT THERE?
Too many ceilings in here. One is plenty.
Hotels are just big boxes. And I've outgrown boxes. Almost.
Is there a snack menu? Asking for a friend. The friend is my stomach.
Nap by the fireplace? That's not a nap, that's a lifestyle.
Cold? Outside? I'll be here, next to anything warm.
Shh. Words are loud.
Sun's out. I'm out. Well, I'm by the window. Same thing.
Nice hotel. Would be nicer with the roof off.
Did you hear? Of course you didn't. Sit down.
Throw something! Anything! I'll chase it with my whole heart.
There's a door upstairs I haven't opened yet. The suspense!
Snacks slow down exploring. Crumbs leave a nice trail, though.
